name: Karina Hart
bio: I'm Karina, co-owner of Take The Lead Services. I'm a qualified and registered veterinary nurse with over 7 years' experience in small animal practice, so you can trust that your pets get the best care and are treated as if they were my own. Since starting Take The Lead I've completed nutrition and body language courses with the IMDT, and in 2017 I gained my NVQ Level 1 & 2 in dog grooming at Merrist Wood. That led to the launch of our grooming salon, The Stylish Dog, in Ash.
